en.name: Egg substitutes, frozen
en.summary: Frozen egg substitute keeps 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Keep it frozen, and cook it as directed for safety. Once cooked, dishes made with it keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. This is a liquid egg product, pasteurised but not sterile, and it is exactly the kind of low-acid, high-protein food the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) was written for. Do not leave a carton out to thaw or to come up to temperature; the two-hour rule applies, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Take out only what you will cook.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and note what that figure describes: it is the recommendation for storage after cooking, not for an open carton of raw substitute sitting in the fridge. For the raw product, thaw it in the fridge and go by the carton's own instructions and printed date, which will be short once opened. Cook it as directed rather than treating it as something you can eat lightly set — that instruction is a safety one, not a texture preference.
en.freezer: 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that window; what you are judging is the product — separation, ice crystals, a dull or greyish colour — rather than the date. Keep the carton upright and sealed, and stand it in a tub, because these cartons expand and sometimes split as the liquid freezes. Do not refreeze a carton that has thawed on the counter.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter or in warm water, and use it within the carton's stated time once liquid. A carton thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: A sour, sulphurous or off smell when the carton is opened.
A pink, grey or greenish tint in the liquid.
Liquid that has separated and will not mix back together after thawing.
A swollen or leaking carton, which goes straight in the bin.
tips: Stand the carton in a tub in the freezer; freezing liquid expands and cartons split.
Thaw only what you will use — you cannot refreeze a warm carton.
Cook it through as the pack directs rather than serving it barely set.
Label the carton with the date you froze it; the printed date assumes it was never frozen.

faq.q: How long do frozen egg substitutes last?
faq.a: 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen, and cook as directed.

faq.q: How do you thaw egg substitute safely?
faq.a: In the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, never on the counter. Use it within the time the carton states once it is liquid.

faq.q: How long do dishes made with egg substitute keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below after cooking, covered.

zh.name: 冷凍蛋液替代品
zh.summary: 冷凍蛋液替代品在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 12 個月。請保持冷凍，並依包裝指示徹底加熱。用它做成的料理煮好後，放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。這是液態蛋製品，經過殺菌但並非無菌，而且正好是 4～60 °C 危險溫度帶當初寫下來要對付的那種低酸高蛋白食物。不要把整盒放在外面退冰或回溫；適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。要煮多少就拿多少。
zh.fridge: 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，而且要看清楚這個數字描述的是什麼：它是「煮熟之後」的建議期限，不是一盒拆封生蛋液擺在冷藏可以放多久。生的產品請在冷藏解凍，並依盒子自己的說明和印製日期為準，拆封後通常很短。也請依指示把它煮熟，不要當成可以半熟食用的東西——那條指示是安全考量，不是口感偏好。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12 個月品質最好。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；你要判斷的是產品本身——分層、冰晶、顏色變暗或發灰——而不是日期。整盒直立密封保存，並且放在一個托盤或盒子裡，因為液體結冰會膨脹，紙盒有時會脹裂。在檯面上退冰過的整盒不要再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面或泡溫水；變成液態之後，請在盒上標示的時間內用完。在冷藏解凍、且始終維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質會打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 打開時聞到酸味、硫磺味或異味。
液體帶粉紅、灰色或偏綠的色調。
解凍後分層，怎麼搖都混不回去。
紙盒鼓脹或滲漏，直接丟掉。
tips: 冷凍時把紙盒立在托盤裡；液體結冰會膨脹，盒子會裂。
只解凍你要用的份量——回溫過的無法再冷凍。
依包裝指示煮熟，不要端上半凝固的狀態。
在盒上寫下冷凍的日期；印製日期假設的是它從未被冷凍過。

faq.q: 冷凍蛋液替代品可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12 個月品質最好。請保持冷凍，並依指示煮熟。

faq.q: 蛋液替代品要怎麼安全解凍？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面。變成液態後請在盒上標示的時間內用完。

faq.q: 用蛋液替代品做的菜可以放多久？
faq.a: 煮熟後蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
